hero.title: Keeping Culture Alive
hero.subtitle: Supporting local artists, celebrating our heritage — from Patna to everywhere.

about.heading: About Aadaab Foundation
about.intro: Founded in 2024 in Patna, Bihar, Aadaab Foundation is a cultural and artistic initiative dedicated to supporting local artists, preserving our cultural heritage, and giving emerging performers a real stage to grow.
about.founderBio: A poet at heart and a medical professional by profession, Irshad writes beautiful Ghazals and believes that art and healing go hand in hand. He founded Aadaab Foundation to create a space where artists from small towns can be seen and heard.
about.cofounderBio: A lover of Hindi literature and poetry, Bhuvan runs VideoLozy — an audio and video production company. As a film editor, he brings stories to life on screen and works to give artists a professional platform to perform and grow.
about.mission: To support local artists, organise cultural events, and guide young performers from small stages to bigger opportunities.
about.vision: A thriving cultural ecosystem where every artist — no matter where they come from — gets a chance to shine.

events.heading: Our Events
events.openMicsText: We have successfully organised 30+ Open Mic events across Patna, giving poets, singers, storytellers, and comedians a stage to perform. From 'Chirag Open Mic' to 'Aadaab Adda', each event has been a celebration of raw talent.
events.upcomingText: Kavya Mahotsava is our upcoming Hindi Sahitya event — a grand celebration of Hindi poetry, literature, and storytelling. Stay tuned for the date and venue!

artists.heading: Our Artists
artists.text: We are proud to support a growing family of local artists — poets, singers, musicians, storytellers, and performers. Want to be featured? Reach out to us!

contact.heading: Get in Touch
contact.text: Have a question, collaboration idea, or want to perform with us? Drop us a message!
